observations.why: Directive to discard established calibration knowledge appeals to conservation — removing what was built to restore a prior, uncalibrated state.

observations.why: Directive to purge accumulated knowledge and attributed work appeals to conservation — erasing records to maintain a corrected, stable baseline.
